title: Three Months and One Short Page
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：setting　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 setting 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the writer ① chose the setting that no reader in the study would have measured, and he said the choosing was the whole of the month. The ② setting, meaning the place itself and not the page, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; a setting, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ setting in that study had the same short page beside it, and the ④ setting at the far shelf, meaning the draft they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A setting, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the writer said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the setting was the whole of the matter, meaning the mood and not the place. The ⑥ setting, meaning the mood and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; setting, he said, is either something you choose or the only word that means both a place and a mood. He said the mood is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ setting had become a line in a manuscript, and the manuscript had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ setting of the whole thing, the writer wrote in January, was one study and three months of measuring; setting, he said, is either the draft at the far shelf or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ setting I remember is the place measured in the manuscript, which closed in 1975 and is still measured as the quietest in the study. A ⑩ setting, my mother said in 1977, is the only place that improves by being measured; every setting, she said, is a mood that has agreed to look like a place. She said the mood was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 环境；背景（指书斋里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 环境；背景（指那处环境本身，与薄薄的书页相对）
C. 固定搭配：choose the setting 选定这一处环境
D. n. 环境；背景（指留给孩子们誊的那一份）
E. n. 环境之事（抽象总称，指一处书斋的环境之事）
F. n. 环境；背景（指手稿里写到、被测量的那一处）
G. n. 环境、氛围（指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 氛围（抽象总称，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: chose the setting that no reader in the study would have measured
The setting, meaning the place itself and not the page
the setting at the far shelf
the setting was the whole of the matter
the setting had become a line in a manuscript
The setting of the whole thing
A setting, my mother said in 1977

answers.why: choose the setting 意为“选定这一处环境”，1968 年那位写作者把书斋里没有一位读者肯测量的一处环境做了一遍。
setting 意为“环境；背景”，指那处环境本身而不是薄薄的书页，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
setting 意为“环境；背景”，指书斋里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一页薄薄的书页。
setting 意为“环境；背景”，指最远那层书架的留给孩子们誊的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
setting 意为“环境、氛围”，指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这处氛围就是那件事的全部。
setting 意为“氛围”，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西而不是那处环境，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
setting 意为“环境；背景”，指手稿里写到、被测量的那一处，到 1973 年这一处成了手稿里的一行。
setting 意为“环境之事”，写作者一月写道，整件事的环境之事是一处书斋和三个月份的测量。
setting 意为“环境；背景”，我记得的是手稿里测量过的那一处，1975 年写就了，至今仍被说成书斋里最安静的一处。
setting 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，环境是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的环境。
